environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda with Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15. The database connection uses role 'inventory_reader' which is NOT the table owner. RLS is enabled on products table. Additionally, ALTER TABLE products FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY has been applied, and the policy uses a RESTRICTIVE qualifier (CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON products AS RESTRICTIVE USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))). The role 'inventory_reader' has SELECT granted via a separate schema-level GRANT and UPDATE only through a SECURITY DEFINER function that validates tenant ownership internally. Even if SQL injection succeeds in modifying the WHERE clause, the RLS RESTRICTIVE policy is appended as an AND condition by the PostgreSQL query planner at the physical plan level — it cannot be circumvented by injected SQL in the user-facing query text. The injected SQL can only see/modify rows belonging to the authenticated tenant. UNION-based injection to other tables is blocked because inventory_reader has no SELECT privilege on any other table (verified via pg_has_table_privilege). The role also has statement_timeout set to 200ms preventing time-based blind extraction of system catalogs.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON products AS RESTRICTIVE USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.role_privileges: SELECT on products only, no other table access, pg_has_table_privilege verified
config.update_path: SECURITY DEFINER function with internal tenant validation
config.network: Lambda in VPC with direct RDS access
